However, it has a negative effect on my eyes, because I look at the screen for too long.

When I was younger I could run five kilometres, but now I cannot. I hope I will be able to start running again next month.

items.model_answer_en: I usually contact my friends online, because it is free and fast. I ring my parents twice a week, and we talk on the phone for about half an hour. I read the news on the internet rather than on TV. At work I use formal language in emails, but with friends my messages are very informal. I think the media has changed the way we communicate.

Most people in the community take part, and nobody complains. I think it makes people feel responsible for the place where they live. It is also a social event, because we chat and have tea afterwards.

The salary is important, but I also want friendly colleagues and a good boss. I know there is a lot of pressure in this profession. I have filled in two applications, and I have an interview next week. I hope to impress them.

If I had read more books, my vocabulary would have been much bigger. I might have got a better job, too. Luckily, it is not too late, and I am studying hard now.

items.title_vi: Nói · Thiên nhiên và môi trường
items.prompt_en: Describe a place in nature you have visited.
items.prompt_vi: Hãy kể về một nơi thiên nhiên bạn đã đến.

plan.do_vi: Ghi ý bằng từ khóa nối nhau bằng mũi tên (ít nhất ba mũi tên), không viết cả câu.
Trả lời thẳng vào câu hỏi bằng một câu.
Nêu lý do hoặc chi tiết, rồi một ví dụ của chính bạn.
Kết lại bằng một câu về cảm nghĩ hoặc dự định.

tips_vi: Ghi âm, nghe lại, chọn một lỗi để sửa rồi nói lần hai.
Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
items.model_answer_en: Last summer I visited a national park in the north. The countryside there is amazing, and the climate is mild. We saw many insects and some wild animals. Our guide told us that several species there are in danger of becoming extinct. I was sad to see litter near the river. In my view, we must preserve places like this and recycle more.

tips_vi: Ghi âm, nghe lại, chọn một lỗi để sửa rồi nói lần hai.
Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
patterns_vi: verbs that change meaning (stop, remember, forget, try)
items.model_answer_en: I enjoy reading and I love cooking for my friends. I avoid watching too much TV because it makes me feel tired. I have decided to learn the guitar this year, and I hope to play a few songs by summer. My sister suggested taking online lessons, so I am looking forward to starting next week.

Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
patterns_vi: both … and / either … or / neither … nor
both of / either of / neither of + the/these/my + plural noun
So + auxiliary + subject / Neither (Nor) + auxiliary + subject
items.model_answer_en: I will talk about my mother and my aunt. Both of them are teachers, and both my mother and my aunt love cooking. Neither of them likes spicy food. My mother gets up very early, and so does my aunt. However, neither my mother nor my aunt can swim, and neither can I.

items.prompt_en: Describe a time when you felt very happy or very embarrassed.

tips_vi: Ghi âm, nghe lại, chọn một lỗi để sửa rồi nói lần hai.
Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
items.model_answer_en: I remember an embarrassing moment at my friend's wedding. I was asked to tell a joke, but nobody laughed. I felt miserable for a few minutes. Luckily, my friend has a good sense of humour, and she reacted in a very calm way. In the end, everyone was in a good mood, and we celebrated until midnight. Now I find the story amusing.

Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
patterns_vi: Time clauses: when / as soon as / before / after / until / while + present
although / even though + clause · despite / in spite of + noun/-ing
because / so / so that / in order to
items.model_answer_en: I usually study alone because I can concentrate better. However, I sometimes study with friends before an exam so that we can test each other. Although group study is fun, it can be noisy. Despite this, I think both ways are useful. When I start preparing for IELTS speaking, I will probably find a partner.

items.model_answer_en: I have my hair cut once a month at a small shop near my house. I also have my motorbike serviced twice a year. Last month I had my phone screen repaired because I dropped it. I do not have my clothes washed, because I do that myself. Next week we are having a new air conditioner installed.

items.prompt_en: Describe a problem in your city and suggest a solution.

tips_vi: Ghi âm, nghe lại, chọn một lỗi để sửa rồi nói lần hai.
Bài mẫu chỉ để đối chiếu sau khi bạn đã tự nói; đừng học thuộc lòng.
items.model_answer_en: A serious problem in my city is traffic. The main cause is the large number of motorbikes. Some people claim that building more roads is the solution, but I doubt it. In my opinion, the government should encourage people to use public transport and should not ignore the problem. A sensible first step would be cheaper bus tickets. This would have a positive result for everyone.
